name: Silly's Difficulty Chart Obby
desc:
🎉 Silly's Difficulty Chart Obby 2 is now out! Play here: https://www.roblox.com/games/10735597938/Sillys-Difficulty-Chart-Obby-2

✨ Welcome to Silly's Difficulty Chart Obby! This obby starts off easy but gets progressively harder the further you get. Do you have the skills needed to reach the end?

🌟 This obby consists of 10 difficulties and a total of 200 stages. You can also choose to rebirth along the way to receive rebirth tokens which you can spend on items in the shop.

💀 Press 'R' to reset character or 'Y' if using a controller.

🔨 Built and scripted by TheManWithASillyName.
